correctness.rationale: Writing h_i=r_i+sum_j b_ij and rho_i=sum_j|b_ij| produces the exact per-capita cancellation at all-ones. At lower/upper cube faces x_i=3/4,5/4, signs follow from L=32(1+H). In logarithmic coordinates the Jacobian logarithmic infinity norm is at most -9L/64+25|h_i|/8+5rho_i/4 <= -9/2, proving inward invariance, uniqueness, and dimension-free e^-9t/2 contraction for every x(0) in Q. A one-species r=b_11=-1 witness excludes universal stabilization using only quadratic per-capita self terms. Independently verified exact rational inequalities for H=0,1,5,100. No attraction outside the cube is proved.

originality.rationale: Çelik et al. establish general arbitrary-coefficient higher-order augmentation for local feasible stability; the published two-degree theorem characterizes admissible degree supports, but expressly allows mixed monomials and gives only local stability. Neither implies the stricter self-only 2n-term construction with uniform invariant cube and global contraction within that cube. These are mathematically different support/dynamical constraints. Inaccessible full text of the closest primary paper remains a material priority risk.
